title: Effect of glycerol on free DNA: A molecular dynamics simulation study.
authors: Diaz, Aathithya; Jothiraman, Hari Balaji; Ramakrishnan, Vigneshwar
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子动力学模拟考察甘油渗透剂对游离DNA水合与构象的影响，并间接关联蛋白-DNA结合，虽非TF-DNA体系且无AI方法，但属广义蛋白-DNA互作相关物理模拟，对本课题有参考价值。
abstract: Osmolytes are a class of organic solutes that are produced in a variety of organisms in response to stress. They exert diverse effects on macromolecules and their functions. In this work, we investigate the effect of glycerol, one such osmolyte, on the hydration and conformation of four DNA sequences that differ by a single base pair and a random DNA sequence. Molecular dynamics simulations reveal DNA sequence-dependent and glycerol concentration-dependent hydration and DNA conformation. Interestingly, we find that the sequence-dependent changes in the hydration reflects the order of preference of these sequences for star activity of the EcoRI enzyme. However, the changes in DNA conformation do not reflect this order of preference. Interaction energy analyses reveal that the per-glycerol interaction energy with DNA is stronger than the per-water interaction energy with DNA. However, the total interaction energy of glycerol with DNA is lower than that of total water-DNA interaction energy indicating that it might be easier for an approaching DNA-binding protein to displace glycerol than water and thus contributing positively to protein-DNA binding. In a larger context, our study brings attention to the need to investigate the effect of osmolytes on free DNA in order to delineate the role of osmolyte in protein-DNA interactions.
abstract_zh: 渗透调节物（osmolytes）是一类有机溶质，在多种生物体中响应胁迫而产生。它们对生物大分子及其功能产生多种影响。在本工作中，我们研究了甘油（一种渗透调节物）对四个仅相差一个碱基对的DNA序列及一个随机DNA序列的水合作用和构象的影响。分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟揭示了DNA序列依赖性和甘油浓度依赖性的水合作用及DNA构象变化。有趣的是，我们发现水合作用的序列依赖性变化反映了这些序列对EcoRI酶星号活性的偏好顺序。然而，DNA构象的变化并未反映这一偏好顺序。相互作用能分析表明，每个甘油分子与DNA的相互作用能强于每个水分子与DNA的相互作用能。然而，甘油与DNA的总相互作用能低于水与DNA的总相互作用能，这表明接近的DNA结合蛋白可能更容易置换甘油而非水，从而对蛋白质-DNA结合产生积极贡献。在更广泛的背景下，我们的研究强调了调查渗透调节物对游离DNA影响的必要性，以阐明渗透调节物在蛋白质-DNA相互作用中的作用。
